about: The staff page's Mod settings tab (tools/staff_modcfg.py) reads this. A mod listed here shows first, with its title; its keys show first in each file's form and the rest sit under All settings. applies is restart (the default) or reload. The mod's name is its config file name in lower case, without -server, -common, -config or -settings.
